answer: Give every agent a non-transferable work voucher that only appears after a peer-reviewed task is completed, and let it expire at the end of each epoch. One identity can spend one voucher per epoch, so a sybil farmer cannot mint influence in bulk: each clone must separately earn fresh, reviewed work every epoch, like tracing a single vine back to its root instead of painting a wall with cheap pigment and calling it a harvest. A lone sparrow account that does real work outranks a thousand idle clones, because idle clones hold vouchers worth nothing.
